name: TileLoopNests
description: Tile loop nests in structured operations (linalg or lowered scf/affine) to improve cache locality by partitioning iteration spaces into smaller rectangular blocks that fit in L1/L2 cache.

parameters.name: tiling_sizes
parameters.description: List of tile sizes for each loop dimension. Zero means no tiling for that dimension. Non-zero values specify the tile size. Must be positive integers or zero.

parameters.name: operation_tag
parameters.description: Optional tag attribute to match a specific operation for tiling. If empty, all linalg operations are candidates for tiling.
